checks.q: Is the basket composition rebalancing resistant to front-running?
Is the NAV (Net Asset Value) calculation accurate and manipulation-resistant?
Are creation/redemption mechanisms protected against arbitrage attacks?
Is the weight normalization mathematically correct after rebalancing?
Are management fees accrued correctly over time?

Are share price calculations consistent between mint and redeem?

Are oracle sources for each basket asset validated independently?

Is the basket update governance properly time-locked?
